author: Jason Stys
summary: Run hash-bound aircraft/operator-loss planning comparisons with planner/reviewer roles and stale-input protection.
rationale: Adds a practical civilian contingency review while preserving the saved plan and explicit resource constraints.
limitations: Synthetic abstract cells, slots and resources; no actual emergency response or aircraft dispatch.
Comparisons preserve the original objective rather than guaranteeing minimum changes to the saved plan.
Truncated comparisons do not prove an optimum or guaranteed loss bound.
Source-first project with current package/service validation; no public native desktop application release is supplied.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
